findings.title: Optional actual access can bind to the wrong acquisition leaf
findings.evidence: Acquiring leaf session-name equality is conditional on requiresAccess. A supplied fresh full access with zero permissions can acquire under another context leaf.
findings.correction: Every supplied actual access matches the exact acquisition leaf/session/source identity, independent of whether witness presence is required. Preserve nilactual/zeroAcquire.

findings.title: Refused continuation claims permit late success to replace uncertainty
findings.evidence: Refused claim sets stopped but not terminal for an already-sent unknown leaf; response branch434 accepts success with original initial-send identity.
findings.correction: Latch refused inflight continuation as terminalunknown; reject contradictory late success/later execution while preserving earlier completed leaves.

findings.title: Explicit human denial still permits durable save
findings.evidence: interact deny stops but candidate/generation/session_save lacks denial guard. Earlier completed/save-approved auth can candidate then later action confirmationdeny and still encryptedsave afterJoin/currentpermission.
findings.correction: Explicit denial withholds subsequent candidate/save, keeping prior authentication outcome; do not impose general save ban for unrelated failure cases.
